card.name: First digit of a multi-digit number
card.fires_on: The first digit (or the space before it) of a number whose remaining digits come next, such as 10, 15, 30, 104 or 120. It appears mostly in dose, model-number and measurement settings.

modes.label: Leading digit of a dose
modes.description: The first digit of a mg/day dose number, with the remaining digit(s) in the next token.

modes.description: The first digit of a model number, flight level or similar code.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: The space just before a number such as a sampling rate.

card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a number that continues with more digits, like the 1 in 15 mg.
